an5.72:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā cetovimuttiphalā ca honti cetovimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca honti paññāvimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca.
an5.72:1.3: Aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā.
an5.72:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā cetovimuttiphalā ca honti cetovimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca honti paññāvimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca. 3.
an5.72:1.5: Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu cetovimutto ca hoti paññāvimutto ca,
an5.72:1.6: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho iti pi, saṃkiṇṇaparikho iti pi, abbuḷhesiko iti pi, niraggalo iti pi, ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto iti pi.
an5.72:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho hoti? 4.
an5.72:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā:
an5.72:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho hoti.
an5.72:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu saṃkiṇṇaparikho hoti? 5.
an5.72:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno ponobbhaviko jātisaṃsāro pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo:
an5.72:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saṃkiṇṇaparikho hoti.
an5.72:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu abbuḷhesiko hoti? 6.
an5.72:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā:
an5.72:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu abbuḷhesiko hoti.
an5.72:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu niraggalo hoti? 7.
an5.72:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno pañc' orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pahīnāni honti ucchinnamūlāni tālāvatthukatāni anabhāvakatāni āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāni:
an5.72:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu niraggalo hoti.
an5.72:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto hoti? 8.
an5.72:6.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno asmimāno pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo:
an5.72:6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto hotī
